primary_implementation: New standalone conservative Roe finite volumes and Miczek spatial flux preconditioning, not an import of the original Numart solver.
matrix_source: Miczek et al.2015 Eq56 / Barsukow et al.2017 Eq31; D=P^-1|PA| with dimensional standard Euler.
time: Physical Euler time derivative unchanged; explicit SSPRK(3,3), acoustic CFL.2 qualified empirically and by a sampled constant-state Fourier scan. No pseudo-time or steady convergence acceleration.
analytical_reference: Separately written continuous vortex evaluator and Gauss cell quadrature; dense-matrix eigendecomposition oracle is separate from the polynomial-action flux. Neither is a separate PDE engine.
changes: Background pressure rescales Mach while beta/velocity/L remain fixed; finite-box Gaussian seam and quadrature are explicitly qualified.
